title: selected vertices and edges
explanation:
### Description

This example selects vertices and edges interactively on a random graph. Click on vertices or edges in the view; a pick callback prints the selected point or cell ID to the console via vtkCellPicker.

**dataset → input → layout → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → selection → output**

- [vtkCellPicker](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCellPicker.html) picks cells and points under the mouse cursor.
- [vtkForceDirectedLayoutStrategy](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkForceDirectedLayoutStrategy.html) computes vertex positions using force simulation.
- [vtkGraphLayout](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGraphLayout.html) applies the layout strategy to the graph.
- [vtkGraphToPolyData](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGraphToPolyData.html) converts graph edges to polydata lines.
- [vtkPolyDataMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyDataMapper.html) maps edge polydata to graphics primitives.
- [vtkRandomGraphSource](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRandomGraphSource.html) generates a random graph.
